details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> hexagon : fix DMA transfers with strides > 24 bits (#31442) * hexagon : fix DMA transfers with strides > 24 bits On v75+ the 2D DMA descriptor stores row_size and strides in 24 bits. dma_queue_push sent oversized strides to fallback_2d, which only splits nrows, so strides of 16 MB or more were truncated - wrong addresses. Fix will fall back to one transfer per row in that case.
